name: omnis-swarm
description: Swarm coordination for Claude Code agents: topology, shared memory and a task board, recorded to an event log for a live read-only swarm pane.

panel.title: Swarm pane
panel.description: command (the default): the pane opens only with /omnis pane or /omnis-swarm:watch. auto: it also opens when a swarm starts. off: it never opens.

budgetAgentMinutes.title: Agent time-box (minutes)
budgetAgentMinutes.description: An agent running this long is asked to wrap up; it is warned at two thirds of it. 1 to 1440.

budgetAgentUsd.title: Agent budget (USD, approximate)
budgetAgentUsd.description: An agent whose estimated spend reaches this is asked to wrap up; it is warned at three fifths. Up to 1000.

budgetSwarmUsd.title: Swarm budget (USD)
budgetSwarmUsd.description: Past this, the lead can't start new agents until you raise it with /omnis budget <usd>; it warns at half. Up to 1000.
